entities.summary: The University of Chicago Booth School of Business is the graduate business school of the University of Chicago, a private research university in Chicago, Illinois, United States. S. and is associated with 10 Nobel laureates in the Economic Sciences, more than any other business school in the world. Booth is part of the M7 group of business schools recognized as having strong MBA programs, that are often highly-ranked in US MBA rankings. Booth School of Business is a business school in Americas, established in 1898. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
